title: Agua de Jamaica (Hibiscus Cooler) with Allspice and Orange
summary: Rinsed dried hibiscus steeps in the fridge with allspice and orange zest, is strained and diluted, then sweetened and served over ice with lime.
equipment: large bowl or jug (at least 2 litres)

ingredients.item: hot water, for dissolving the sugar

steps.title: Rinse
steps.text: Put the hibiscus in the sieve and rinse well under cold water to remove any dust, then drain.

steps.title: Steep cold
steps.text: Tip the flowers into the bowl with the allspice, orange zest and 1 litre cold water. Cover and leave in the fridge for 4-12 hours; the longer it steeps, the deeper and tarter it gets.

steps.title: Strain and dilute
steps.text: Pour through the fine sieve into the pitcher, pressing firmly on the flowers, then discard them. Add the remaining 1 litre cold water.

steps.title: Sweeten
steps.text: Stir the sugar into the hot water until fully dissolved, then add it to the pitcher. Taste and add a little more if you like it sweeter.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pour over ice in tall glasses and add a lime wedge.

tips: Hibiscus stains, so use glass or stainless steel rather than plastic.
Sweeten after diluting so you can judge the balance of tart and sweet.
A short 4-hour steep gives a lighter, fruitier drink; overnight is bolder.
Freeze some in an ice-cube tray so the drink doesn't water down.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 5 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
